notes.title: Hotfix for saving
notes.notes:
- Fixes an issue where some user's security settings prevented loading their saves
This issue didn't affect the saving process, so exisitng saves are unaffected

notes.title: Game Release
notes.notes:
At long last Escape the Farm is released and avilable to download. Preen those parkour feathers and move up the pecking order now.

It's been a long road but we're finally there. A big thank you to the testing team for really raising the quality of the product up. We would never have got there without you!

Although it's now out there in the wild we know this is just the beginning! Stay tuned for game updates and enhancements.
